title: From Trillion-Code Open Source to Domestic Computing Power Collaboration: Kimi K3 and MoLi Thread Intelligent Computing Card Complete Full Stack Adaptation

content_html:
On the evening of July 28, Moonshot AI officially open-sourced the 2.8 trillion parameter model Kimi K3 and released the model weights and technical report; on the same day, MoLeThread's official Weibo announced that it had completed the ultra-fast adaptation and stable startup of Kimi K3 based on its AI training and inference integrated smart computing card MTT S5000 and MUSA software stack.

As the first globally open-sourced large model at the 3 trillion parameter level and the most powerful version of Kimi so far, Kimi K3 features 2.8 trillion parameters and a 100,000 token context window, natively supports visual understanding, and integrates several architectural innovations such as the KDA hybrid linear attention mechanism (Kimi Delta Attention), attention residuals, Gated MLA, and Stable LatentMoE, specifically designed for cutting-edge intelligent scenarios such as long-range programming, knowledge work, and complex reasoning.

This ultra-fast adaptation not only demonstrates MoLeThread's MUSA software ecosystem's rapid response and full-stack collaboration capabilities for cutting-edge large-scale models, but also further verifies the solid capabilities of domestic full-function GPUs in supporting the research and development and engineering implementation of trillion-parameter large models. With the deep integration of high-performance domestic computing power and top-tier open-source ecosystems, the large model industry is accelerating towards an efficient, self-controlled, and fully integrated hardware-software innovation stage.

content_html_zh:
7月28日晚，Moonshot AI正式开源2.8万亿参数模型Kimi K3，并发布模型权重和技术报告；同日，MoLeThread官方微博宣布，基于其AI训练推理一体智能计算卡MTT S5000和MUSA软件栈，完成了Kimi K3的超快适配和稳定启动。

作为全球首个开源的3万亿参数级别的大型模型，也是Kimi迄今为止最强大的版本，Kimi K3拥有2.8万亿参数和10万个token上下文窗口，原生支持视觉理解，并集成了KDA混合线性注意力机制（Kimi Delta Attention）、注意力残差、Gated MLA、Stable LatentMoE等多项架构创新，专为远程编程、知识等前沿智能场景而设计。工作和复杂的推理。

此次超快适配不仅展现了MoLeThread MUSA软件生态对前沿大型模型的快速响应和全栈协作能力，也进一步验证了国产全功能GPU支持万亿参数大型模型研发和工程实施的扎实能力。 随着国产高性能算力与顶级开源生态的深度融合，大模型产业正加速走向高效、自主可控、软硬件全面融合的创新阶段。
